svg.text: Zero Trust Remote Access Gateway — AWS Verified Access
Per-application, per-request authorisation. No network-level trust. Region us-east-1.
Policies are ANDed, not merged. Cedar is
No Internet Gateway route. No public IPs. No SSH.
two AZs required by AWS for an ALB
3 interface VPC endpoints · IAM role · no inbound port,
no SSH key, every session logged in CloudTrail
said is authenticated, MFA-verified, and on the same
network as AdminApp — and still never reaches it.
The application never sees the request at all.
Every decision recorded — allowed and denied alike.
Enforcement without a record is a control nobody can
audit, investigate, or prove after the fact.
Both applications sit on the same subnet, in the same VPC, behind the same Verified Access group.
They share plumbing and share no trust. Network position confers nothing — every request to every application is authorised independently.
